name: Courier Cars
description: Cars to drive round Courier World, a tiny-planet courier game on Robinhood Chain: nineteen of Courier World's own designs, from the post office's red van and a yellow taxi to a monster truck, a race car and a golden limo, each a limited kind. Bought only with $STAMP, all of it to the Courier World treasury. Drive one and everyone in the game sees your car; cars never change what you earn. Play: https://courierworld.fun/ - X: https://x.com/PlayCourierWld
